🕶️ Welcome to Arise Army Tycoon!

Begin your journey as a lone summoner and build a powerful Solo Levelling Army from the ground up! Conquer gates, unlock elite generals like Beru and Igris, command your legion, and rise through the ranks to become the ultimate Monarch! Upgrade your fortress, summon rare shadows, battle monsters, and discover secret realms waiting in the dark…

💾 Your tycoon saves automatically, so your progress is never lost!
👍 Smash that like button to help awaken even more shadow power!
🎁 Join the group for a big in-game bonus!
